scientific_choices.rationale: Paper section 3.2/Figure 3 specifies attention-gated U-Net with pretrained ResNet50; section 4.1 specifies BCE/Adam families.
Reuse disjoint owners, separators, paired flip/rotation, frozen ResNet50 and original qualified source checkpoint. Do not mutate source masks, shared implementations or previous reports.

Audit square512/768/1024 and rectangular576x1024 before training. The rectangle preserves 16:9 ICDAR image aspect without square padding. Choose a larger training resolution only on fixed TRAIN validation geometry.

All branches start from the same epoch38 convolutional/affine weights, fresh Adam, LR1e-5, twenty complete epochs and identical FIT/validation IDs. Include epoch zero to prevent forced degradation. The historical 100-epoch baseline is preserved.

Equal foreground BCE contribution per surviving word, equal aggregate foreground/background contribution, separator-weighted background and local per-word Dice weight0.5. Ignore other word owners in each Dice ROI. GT is training supervision only.

Replace only decoder/bottleneck BatchNorm by GroupNorm using at most32 groups dividing the channel count. Preserve affine parameters and convolution weights; encoder normalization stays frozen. This deviates from paper BatchNorm and requires a distinct architecture identity.

Compare every resolution on identical original-coordinate care boxes, not resolution-dependent GT target envelopes. Select each epoch by geometry and the final branch by correct-word alphanumeric F1 on the fixed100-image TRAIN validation. No TEST selection.

Actual PAPER RTX3090/24GiB, FP32 batch8 with TF32 disabled and sequential model phases. Qualify each larger-input backward pass and record allocated/reserved peaks; errors propagate without reduced-batch or precision substitution.
